subject: gk
question: The festival of Pushkaralu is celebrated to promote the cultural heritage of which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Andhra Pradesh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Tungabhadra Pushkaram festival was celebrated in Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh, on the banks of river Tungabhadra.
 
• The festival is observed for a period of 12 days.__
 
• Andhra Pradesh CM Jaganmohan Reddy commenced the Pushkaram at Sankal Bagh ghat.
 
• Like previous years, no Pushkaram (synonymous with holy dips) will be allowed this year due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
